extDescription.message: Transparent, click-through PiP that dodges your cursor. Works across streaming and video sites.
extDescription.description: Store summary. Must stay under 132 characters.

cmdMute.message: Toggle mute on the video tab

modeWeb.description: Floating video inside the browser tab.

modeWebTitle.message: Web mode (overlay inside the browser tab)

modeFull.description: Floating video window on the desktop, outside the browser.

btnReturn.description: Closes the floating video and returns it to the page.

btnSourceTab.description: Switches to the tab the video comes from.

masterHint.message: Turning this off closes the overlay and the engine

clickThrough.description: Mouse clicks pass through the video window to what is behind it.

autoDodge.description: The video window moves away when the mouse comes near.

hotkeyBtnTitle.message: Click, then press a new shortcut

tipHold.message: Even during click-through, hold $HOLD$ to move, resize, or change the opacity with the scroll wheel.

tipNativePip.message: Opacity, click-through and auto-dodge also apply to windows opened with a site's or the browser's own PiP button.

guideSub.message: Transparent, click-through, auto-dodging PiP that never blocks your screen

guideStep1Body.message: Two buttons appear at the top of videos on YouTube, Twitch, CHZZK, SOOP and OTT services such as Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video.

guideWebModeBody.message: A floating window inside the browser tab. It follows you to other tabs. Nothing to install.

guideFullModeBody.message: A window that floats over games and other programs. Opacity, click-through and auto-dodge need GhostPiP Engine.

guideStep2a.description: Keep the HTML tags and file names.

guideStep2b.description: Keep the HTML tags and file names.

guideStep2c.message: You're done when the status at the top right of this page changes to Engine connected.
guideStep2c.description: Keep the HTML tags. Use the same wording as engineConnected.

guideEngineNote.message: The engine installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\GhostPiP, runs only while Chrome has Full mode open, and exits when you turn GhostPiP off. To remove it, run uninstall.bat.
guideEngineNote.description: Keep the HTML tags and paths.

guideAvTitle.message: If your antivirus blocks the engine

guideAvBody.message: The engine shows a transparent window over other windows and forwards mouse input, so some antivirus products (e.g. Avast Win64:Evo-gen) may flag unsigned builds by mistake. It never uses the network or collects files.

guideAv2.message: Add the %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\GhostPiP folder to your antivirus exclusions.

guideMoveResizeHow.message: Drag while holding <kbd class="hold">Ctrl+Alt</kbd> / drag an edge

guideHotkeyNote.message: Change hotkeys and the modifier key from the GhostPiP toolbar icon → Hotkeys & controls.

engineTrayTip.description: Windows tray icon tooltip. Keep the product name.

engineTrayEmergency.description: Tray menu item. The hotkey is appended in parentheses.

peekModeHint.message: Hide until you hold the peek key

tipElevated.message: Over games running as administrator, the Ctrl+Alt hold can't reach the PiP. Use Alt+G to toggle click-through instead.

tipMediaHotkeys.message: While a PiP is playing, Alt+Left, Alt+Right and Alt+Space control the video and override Back, Forward and the window menu.

allSitesNeedsPermission.message: Allow access to all sites to use this.
